brief.analystNote: BTC at $63,230 sits in a structurally sound but uninspiring position — 40% through the Phase A accumulation range ($53,528–$77,885) with MVRV 1.185 confirming fair value, not distress. Counter-balancing this, ETF flows printed -$23M on June 11 — well below the $264M/day institutional baseline — and stablecoin supply contracted $1.3B over 7 days, suggesting institutional capital remains cautious and dry powder is not being positioned aggressively for a BTC re-entry. The 20d SMA at $68,131 is the first meaningful resistance level, and until BTC reclaims it on a daily close, the bias is systematic accumulation within the DCA framework rather than aggressive deployment.
